changes.orig_value: Upper hinge/pivot bracket has flat-topped cylindrical boss with sharp square shoulder transition to body
changes.revised_value: Upper hinge/pivot bracket has continuous curved/filleted profile transitioning smoothly from the round boss down to the body without a square shoulder step
changes.rationale: The upper pivot boss area changed from a stepped/square-shouldered profile to a fully blended curved fillet, which alters the stress concentration geometry and potentially the fit of mating hinge components.

changes.orig_value: Sharp/square corner at upper-left front edge of top flange (no fillet visible)
changes.revised_value: Fillet/radius added at upper-left front edge of top flange
changes.rationale: The revised view shows a visible fillet radius on the upper-left corner of the top flange area where the original had a sharp corner, indicating a geometry change that affects stress concentration and potentially fit with mating parts.

The radius callout changed from 'ALL AROUND' (implying continuous application around the full profile) to '4X' (explicitly counting 4 discrete instances), which alters the manufacturing scope and inspection criteria for this fillet/radius feature.

The insert specification note was changed from 'TAP FOR #4-40 HELICOIL' to 'FOR #4-40 HELICAL INSERTS', which alters the manufacturing callout for the threaded insert installation process and brand/type designation.
The quantity multiplier for the R.030 radius callout was reduced from 16X to 8X, indicating fewer instances of this radius feature are now specified on the part.

changes.revised_value: Upper pocket geometry updated with additional R.093 and R.063 radii features
changes.rationale: The pocket corner geometry in the upper half of the part appears to have changed shape, consistent with the addition of the R.093 and R.063 radius callouts replacing or supplementing some of the previously specified R.030 corners.
